title: [Tips&Tricks] Discover Better Workflow with Marvelous Designer and Unreal Engine
content: Through our collaborative efforts, we’re excited to introduce two new features for our community: the LiveSync plugin and USD export simulation data. In this article, we’ll explore how these powerful tools can elevate your workflow. Both the**LiveSync plugin** and **USD Export for Simulation Data** are tailored for users who frequently toggle between Marvelous Designer and Unreal Engine, but each serves a different purpose. * **LiveSync Plugin** : The feature is primarily aimed at simplifying the tedious import and export process. mesh, materials, skeletal animations, and geometry caches can all be imported and exported with just one click. * **USD Export Simulation Data** : Specifically designed to work with Unreal Engine 5.4's updated **Chaos Cloth** feature, this tool enables real-time simulation effects, translating complex clothing physics from Marvelous Designer directly into Unreal Engine. Let’s dive into how these tools enhance the design and animation workflow by walking through a case study featuring a fairy character animation sequence. ![Cenimetics_cc03_Still001.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438057410201) ## **Designing the Fairy Garment in Marvelous Designer** Before we jump into Unreal Engine, let's explore how we crafted the fairy's outfit in Marvelous Designer. ** ** **1\. Starting with a Simple T-Shirt Base** Marvelous Designer offers multiple ways to begin garment creation. For this project, we started by dragging a T-shirt pattern into the 2D window as a base. With the **Style Line tool,** we could quickly split and modify the T-shirt into a completely different style by adjusting the pattern directly in the 3D window, with real-time updates reflected in the 2D pattern. ![StyleLine_merged.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437978960409)**2\. Layering and Fabric Simulation** Marvelous Designer excels in simulating multi-layered garments. For the fairy outfit, we duplicated the underskirt pattern and added lace detail using internal lines. Each layer contributes to the garment’s dynamic, three-dimensional look. To simulate different fabric properties, we added a Muslin fabric preset from Marvelous Designer’s library of 77 fabric types, which changes the folds and flow of the skirt during simulation. ![08.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438009386649) **3\. Creating Petal Patterns and Pleating Effects** Using the Polygon Tool, we traced petal shapes for the skirt from a photo, then applied accordion pleat effect with the Internal Polygon Tool and Pleat Tool. The result was an elegant, multi-layered skirt with beautiful texture and movement. Thanks to Marvelous Designer's new PBR Texture Generator, we were also able to auto-generate texture maps (normal, opacity, metalness, displacement) with a single click, further enhancing the realism.![flower_paddle.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438009738777) ![06.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438009893657) **4\. Adding Ruffles and Topstitching**** **For the finishing touch, we created ruffles by sewing longer pattern edges onto shorter ones. And using the**Topstitch Tool** , we added stitching details that elevated the garment’s realism. ![TopStitch.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438058599321) After completing the garment design and the initial simulation in Marvelous Designer, we move on to caching the animation. ## **Animation Caching** First, using the **Pin Tool** , we secure certain parts of the garment to the character model by double-clicking the edge lines of the pattern pieces, quickly pinning the entire line. The **Tack Tool** is another way we can constrain the fabric to the model, while also allowing for length adjustments that control the distance between the fabric and the model. To cache the animation, we change the simulation preset to **Animation** , reduce the gravity value and increase air damping to simulate a floating, fairy-like effect. When all settings are in place, we click **Record** to start recording the animation cache. This cache will store all the necessary animation data, which can later be exported to Unreal Engine with full fidelity, preserving all simulation effects.** ** ## ![MD_Sim.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438058798361)**Calla Lily Creation** The vegetation in the scene is also modeled and simulated using Marvelous Designer. During the animation recording process, we can adjust the position and angle of the wind in real-time to create these natural dynamic effects. Marvelous Designer’s keyframe editing tool allows us to create perfect looping animations without frame skips—ideal for in-game sequences. Similar to video editing tools, we can cut layers and move layers horizontally. Copy the first frame and paste it at the end of the animation. The last frame of the animation blends into the first frame, creating a perfect cycle animation.** ** ![CalaLily.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438058959257) Once the animation was complete, both the fairy's garment and the calla lily were imported into Unreal Engine using the LiveSync Plugin, which maintains the accuracy of materials, animations, and textures during the transfer. ## **Transfer to Unreal Engine with LiveSync** Now that the fairy’s garment is complete, it’s time to bring the animation into Unreal Engine using the **LiveSync plugin**. After Install and Activate LiveSync, ensure that Marvelous Designer is running, then open the **LiveSync Editor** in Unreal Engine, and click the “Update” button.** ** ![LiveSync.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437980377625) The scene in Marvelous Designer is imported into the LiveSync Editor. In the editor, we can see that the shader balls have been automatically created based on the fabrics assigned in Marvelous Designer. We can also activate Unified Material; by clicking update again, the plugin will generate unified materials based on UV coordinates.![calalily_02.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438026338969)The capabilities of the **LiveSync plugin** aren’t limited to importing. MetaHuman characters, or any skeletal meshes, can be exported to and from Unreal Engine. Making it easier to create and simulate clothing for your characters. With all assets successfully imported, we used Unreal Engine’s **Sequencer** to animate and render the final scene. The fairy’s clothing, wings, and environment elements like calla lilies were all modeled and simulated in Marvelous Designer before being synchronized with Unreal Engine via the **LiveSync plugin**. ![light.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438011161625) ## **Leveraging Chaos Cloth with USD Export** **![gameplay_01.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437994671641)**The LiveSync plugin is suitable for rendering animations, creating videos, and cinematics using Unreal Engine. It can also be used to import environmental assets from Marvelous Designer (such as the calla lilies in this scene). But for users seeking real-time fabric simulation, Marvelous Designer’s**USD Export Simulation Data** is an invaluable asset, especially when paired with Unreal Engine’s **Chaos Cloth**. Let’s break down the process:** ** ![S01.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438060052249) **Optimizing for Chaos Cloth** : The fairy’s garment, with its complex layering, needed to be optimized before importing into Unreal Engine. By splitting the dress into three parts—skinned mesh, simulation mesh, and render mesh. ![05.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438043457817)**Auto-Retopology** and **Rigging** : The garment that does not need to participate in the simulation is skinned to the character’s body. The close-fitting garment does not need to participate in the simulation. Using Marvelous Designer’s **EveryWear Toolkit** , we performed automatic retopology and rigging. EveryWear is an automatic optimization toolkit for virtual clothing in games. Marvelous Designer's Quad Optimize option can achieve auto retopology. And with the EveryWear tool, we can reduce the polygon count. Rigging feature is also a part of EveryWear tool set. We can first specify the maximum number of influencing joints. Unreal Engine supports a maximum of 8 joints, so we set it to 8. Click 'Apply,' and the weights of the body mesh will automatically be copied to the garment. The skin weight can be painted and smooth using the brush tools. And we can use Hammer Tool and Repair brushes from the sculpting toolset to fix any intersections. ![Retpop.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438027448729)![Rigging.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438032351769) The primary challenge with this fairy's dress is that the petal skirt has too many layers, making it heavy and complex. The approach we used to optimize the skirt was to represent the multiple layers through textures instead of geometry. First, we split the skirt into two parts and unfolded it. Then, we created a simplified proxy model and used an orthographic view to render different AOV channels as texture maps. This significantly simplified the geometry, while the textures gave the illusion of layered complexity. ![04.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438060833689)![04 copy.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437995843737) (The left image shows the skirt unfolded in Marvelous Designer, and the right image illustrates how these layers are represented using textures.) ## **Optimizing Polygon Count** To further optimize the model, we need to reduce the polygon count. One way to do this is by increasing the particle distance in Marvelous Designer. When simulating fabric in 3D, random triangles tend to create more natural-looking folds. Using triangular meshes instead of quads works well with Chaos Cloth in Unreal Engine, so there’s no need to retopologize or convert to quads. Simply increasing the particle distance value will reduce the number of faces. Another important factor is increasing the collision thickness, which creates more separation between fabric layers. In this case, the collision thickness was increased from the default 2.5 mm to 5 mm for better results in Chaos Cloth.** ** ## ![CollisionThickness_03.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438032993177)**Exporting the USD File ** Once the model is optimized, we can export the USD file. Uncheck the option to export all avatars, select multiple objects in the export settings, and enable the "thick" option and unified UV coordinates. Crucially, ensure that the **Include garment simulation data** option is enabled. This will preserve all the physical properties assigned in Marvelous Designer, such as shrinkage and collision settings, so they can be read by Unreal Engine’s Chaos Cloth. ![SimulationProp \(1\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438033211929) ## **ClothAsset Setup in Unreal Engine** Back in Unreal Engine, we need to create a **ClothAsset**. Import the USD file exported from Marvelous Designer and select the skeletal mesh, which was also imported using the Marvelous Designer LiveSync plugin. This process skins the clothing to the character. In the preview scene, make sure to select the same skeletal mesh again.** ** ## **Painting Weights for Maximum Distance** Next, we’ll paint weights for the maximum distance property. It controls which parts of the fabric will participate in the simulation. Areas painted with 0 value represent regions that will not be simulated and are instead skinned directly to the character’s body. Use a smooth brush to create a gradient effect for the weights. You can paint weights in either the 2D or 3D views. If working in 2D, the layout and arrangement of the patterns are identical to what we see in the 2D window of Marvelous Designer. To make it easy for weight painting, make sure to pay attention to the layout of the patterns before exporting the USD file. The pattern pieces should not be too close together or have any overlapping. After painting the weights, click 'Accept' to preview the simulation results.** ** ![03.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438013248537) The weight values we painted can be adjusted using the **SimulationMaxDistanceConfig** node, which controls the highest and lowest weight values. Lowering the maximum value can further optimize the simulation. ## ## **Fabric Physical Properties ** The next three nodes are used to define the physical properties of the fabric. Normally, adjusting fabric properties is the most complex part of cloth simulation, but since we exported the physical properties from Marvelous Designer, this step becomes much simpler. By enabling the arrow icon on each parameter, we can directly use the fabric properties imported from Marvelous Designer.** ** ![SimData.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47437996767769) Additionally, a clothing icon next to the nodes allows us to use the weight map generated in Marvelous Designer. Different fabric presets were applied to different patterns in Marvelous Designer, and the weight map is automatically exported with the USD file. ![SimData02.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438029196185) To enable the clothing to collide with the character’s body, we need to create a physics asset. This asset should be added to the **SetPhysicsAsset** node in Unreal Engine. ## ![PhysicsAssets.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438062365977)**Other Key Nodes for Cloth Simulation** * **SimulationCollisionConfig** : Controls fabric thickness and friction. Enabling the arrow icon will use values imported from Marvelous Designer. * **Self Collision** : Disabled by default for optimization. Enabling it will allow basic self-collision using spheres. Or use the more precise but more costly collisions through the **SimulationSelfCollisionConfig node.** * **SimulationSolverConfig:** This node manages global settings for the solver. Increasing the number of iterations strengthens the stiffness of constraints, but increases CPU load. Adjust the **Substep** value to improve collision accuracy at the cost of higher CPU load. Both settings must be optimized for performance and accuracy. You can also add aerodynamic effects to the simulation. By introducing wind fields, the clothing will move naturally during idle animations, making the character appear more lifelike. ## ## **Level of Detail (LOD) Settings** The final part of the preset involves configuring **LOD (Level of Detail)** settings. Different LODs will activate based on the camera’s distance from the character. The physical properties we configured earlier are connected to the top collection. A **Remesh** node is added to the middle LOD collection to reduce mesh density. The bottom collection, connected directly from the skinning node, doesn’t include dynamic simulation. If we want fabric simulation to be active all the time during gameplay, this collection can be removed.** ** ![02.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438034423193) ## ## **Merging the Simulation and Render Meshes** If a proxy model was used for simulation, we need to remove it as the render mesh using a**Delete Elements** node. Then, import a detailed render mesh, either as a static mesh or through a USD import node. Then use the **Merge Cloth Collection** node to combine the simulation mesh with the new render mesh.** ** ![RenderMesh.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438062736025) ## ** Final Setup in the Character Blueprint** In the character’s blueprint, add a**Chaos Cloth Component** and parent it to the character. Select the cloth asset we just created and adjust the position and rotation parameters if necessary. Compile and save the blueprint.** ** ![Character.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438048068761) Now, the clothing has real-time fabric simulation properties and will react naturally in the game environment. ![Still.jpg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438048200601)Whether you’re creating cinematic sequences or in-game assets, the combination of Marvelous Designer’s **LiveSync plugin** and **USD Export Simulation Data** delivers a seamless, efficient workflow. The tools allow for rich, detailed simulations and quick iterations, significantly enhancing productivity. ![01.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438030245913)To explore these tools for yourself, the fairy model and garment are available for free download on our official [CONNECT store](https://connect.clo-set.com/). These files are intended for educational use and cannot be used for commercial purposes.
content_description: Discover how our new LiveSync plugin and USD Export Simulation Data features streamline the workflow between Marvelous Designer and Unreal Engine, enhancing your design and animation capabilities.

title: Troubleshooting Login Loop Issues on Marvelous Designer Website
content: If you are trying to sign in to the Marvelous Designer website using 'sign in with CLO-SET' but you are redirected back to the main page without logging in, please follow the steps below: 1. Go to [style.clo-set.com](https://style.clo-set.com) and '**Sign Out** ' and **sign-in again**. 2. Go to [marvelousdesigner.com](https://marvelousdesigner.com) and sign in with '**Sign in with CLO-SET** ' option. The issue may be stemming from having an log login session stored on your browser. If the issue persists, please contact support at support@marvelousdesigner.com with detailed information about the problem, including screenshots and recordings.
content_description: This webpage provides troubleshooting steps for users experiencing login issues with the Marvelous Designer website when using the 'sign in with CLO-SET' feature.

title: How can I reset my password on Marvelous Designer Web and the Software?
content: # How to reset your password varies depending on the version of your software. ## **Marvelous Designer version 2024.0 and above** Please click on the 'Change Password from CLO-SET' button on the Account page, and you will be redirected to the 'My Page' section of CLO-SET, where you can change your password. ## **Marvelous Designer version below 2024.0** Please click on the 'Reset password' button in the Marvelous Designer License Password box on the Account page. * If you have CLO-SET account and are using a version of the software below 2024.0, your license password will not be synchronized with the password of your CLO-SET account. ## **Forgot my password** If you are already a member of CLO-SET, please follow the indicated guidelines below: 1. On the [Sign-in](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/en/member/signin?returnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marvelousdesigner.com%2Fsupport%2Fcontact) page, please select "SIGN IN WITH CLO-SET" option. 2. Then, click on the '[Forgot your password?](https://style.clo-set.com/en/account/password/find?returnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marvelousdesigner.com%2Fsupport%2Fcontact&uaa=1)' button. 3. Enter an email address to receive a link to reset your password. 4. Check your email and follow the directions indicated in the email. If you haven't integrated your account with CLO-SET yet, please follow the indicated guidelines below: 1. Navigate to the [Sign-in](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/en/member/signin?returnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.marvelousdesigner.com%2Fsupport%2Fcontact) page on Marvelous Designer website. 2. Click on the "[Forgot your password?](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/identify)" button. 3. Enter an email address to receive a link to reset your password. 4. Check your email and follow the directions indicated in the email. * If you are unable to access your email to reset your password, please reach out to CLO via [Contact Us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact) page.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions on how to reset your password for different versions of Marvelous Designer and CLO-SET accounts.

title: How to Prevent Marvelous Designer File Corruption
content:
**Objective** This article describes why Marvelous Designer project file .zprj and garment file .zpac are corrupted and how to prevent them.
``` Failed to read the Project file: Unzip error~
``` ![Screenshot 2023-01-27 165004.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438263659289) **Problem Situations** * When launching Marvelous Designer, get an error saying failed to read the project file. * When opening a project file saved on the computer, it says it is unreadable. * When trying to save the file, it says it can't be saved. * Opening the file takes a long time and eventually fails. * * * **Causes and Solutions** **Case 1.** **Disk Full... Actually** ![01 - Disk Full.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438263938329) * If disk space is insufficient during the process of designing and saving garments in Marvelous Designer, file corruption may actually occur. So make sure you have enough free space on your PC's drive. * We recommend that you have at least 20GB of free space to install and run Marvelous Designer. You can make free space by deleting or backing up unnecessary files. * **See also: [Marvelous Designer System Requirements](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219834649)** **Case 2.** **Mechanical Malfunction and/or Connection Failure** ![02 - Mechanical-Malfunction.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438264140441) * File corruption may occur due to physical failure, disk error, or poor connection. * You can check disk status through the built-in disk management app or disk management utility on Windows and macOS. * In case of physical failure, contact your company's IT support department or the place of purchase. **Case 3.** **No Permission to File Read and Write** ![03 - No Permission.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438236469145) * All computer operating systems, including Windows and macOS, have permission to read/write your files. If you do not have or only have partial permissions to read/write, Marvelous Designer file corruption may occur. The following post explains how to gain read/write permissions for Marvelous Designer files on Windows and macOS. **[Disk access rights required when Marvelous Designer running](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358175269657)** * If you are a corporate customer, please contact your company's IT/Security department. **Case 4.** **Blocking File Read and Write, or Data Tampering by Security Apps** ![04 - Blocking file RW.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438252037529) * Certain security programs, such as antivirus and Internet communication monitoring tools, may restrict Internet access and file creation of software such as Marvelous Designer. **In their detailed settings, change the Marvelous Designer Internet access and file read/write settings to "Allow".** * In the case of enterprise companies, they often use stronger security solutions than those described above, and in some cases, the files themselves created by Marvelous Designer are tampered with. For corporate users, please contact your IT/Security department. **Case 5.** **Two or More Marvelous Designer Running Simultaneously** ![05 - Two or more CLOs Running.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438249085081) * If you use two or more Marvelous Designer at the same time, there is a possibility that the internal data of the Marvelous Designer project file may be lost or corrupted. * All you know that it's a good way to save file often. And **if you need to save the final result, save it with only one Marvelous Designer running.** **Case 6.** **External Storage Connection Failure** ![06 - External Storage.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438215098393) * File corruption may occur while reading or writing Marvelous Designer files on external storage such as USB stick or portable hard disk. Although these are convenient, in reality, physical detection failures and connection failures are relatively frequent. * When transferring files between an external device and your PC, it often appears that the file-transfer has been complete, but in reality, the all data has not been completely transferred. To check whether the file was completely transferred, simply compare the file size. * **In summary, allow plenty of time when exchanging files with external storage devices.** **Case7** **Network Drive or Cloud Sync Failure** ![07 - Network Drives.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438232214297) * If you use a NAS and various Internet cloud sync services, Marvelous Designer files may be corrupted during file transfer over the network. Additionally, cloud sync services may have problems that removing or damaging files on the local computer during the sync process. * If you use a cloud sync service, set it to sync only specific folders, excluding folders and directories referenced by the Marvelous Designer. **For example, disable syncing your Desktop and Documents folders.** * * * **Read More** **1** For example, the size of the zprj and zpac files, including Marvelous Designer basic t-shirt and basic avatar, is approximately 20MB. If your files are smaller than expected, it means the internal data may be corrupted. If your project file is less than 1MB in size, it cannot be recovered because all clothing data inside the file has been lost. **2** When recording animations of flashy, heavy garments, the project file size will be very large, and this animation recording data may be fragile in some user scenarios. If you are recording a long animation, dividing the entire scene into sections as shown below will help prevent file corruption. ![008_MD.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438300166681) * * * **File Recovery** If you would like to recover your file, please send us your problem file as is via **[Contact Us](https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact)**.
content_description: This web page aims to educate users on the common causes of corruption in Marvelous Designer project and garment files, along with preventive measures to avoid such issues.

title: I have a verification issue. What should I do?
content: # **Objective** This FAQ will cover the trouble shooting for a verification issue. # **Details** Please use Chrome instead of other internet browsers. Marvelous Designer, and CLO-SET website is optimized as Chrome. **[CASE 1]** If you didn't receive the verification email, please check your spam mailbox. Sometimes the verification email can be found in your spam folder, or you will need to refresh your browser. **[CASE 2]** If Marvelous Designer web requires verification, even if you already verify it, please remove your old cookie and cache. **In Chrome** 1. On your computer, open Chrome. 2. At the top right, click More. 3. Click "Clear Browsing History". 4. Select a period on the top. To **delete** everything, select All time. 5. Activate the checkboxes next to "**Cookies** and other site data" and "**Cached** images and files". 6. Click Clear data. **[CASE 3]** Some school domains block external emails. If so, you can check your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from Marvelous Designer. If you still have not received your verification email, please reach out to Marvelous Designer via [Contact Us](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/member/signin?returnpage=contact).
content_description: This FAQ page provides troubleshooting steps for resolving verification issues with Marvelous Designer and CLO-SET, emphasizing the use of Chrome for optimal performance.

title: Disk access rights required when Marvelous Designer running
content: In order for the Marvelous Designer to operate smoothly, sufficient read and write rights are required on the disk in the user's computer. This 'read and write rights' must apply to all storage devices in the user's computer, including hard disk and SSD. Usually, this task is done in the same way as installing with admin rights and running with admin rights, and through this way, various unexpected errors also can be prevented. **Please note** that this may require assistance from the administrator of your computer, i.e. your IT or security team. **Common problematic situations** * Unable to launch Marvelous Designer, it is not responding. * Able to run Marvelous Designer, but not responding when using certain functions. * Not responding or crashes when loading or saving certain files. * * * **Windows** 1 After logging in to Windows with the Windows administrator profile, install the Marvelous Designer with administrator privileges. * If your school or company security policy requires you to log in to Windows with guest privileges rather than administrator privileges, go to step 2 below. 2 After exiting the Marvelous Designer, go to the path where the Marvelous Designer software is installed. 3 Right-click the Marvelous Designer executable file, select Properties, and select Users from the Security tab. 4 Click Edit and change the permissions as shown in the picture. Read & execute, Read, Write items must be selected. 5 When you're done applying permissions, choose Apply. ![002_Windows.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358152648473) * * * **macOS** 1 Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access. 2 Click the + button at the bottom of the window, select the Marvelous Designer from Applications, and select Open. 3 Select Marvelous Designer and enable toggle switch. ![MD_Full_Disk_Access \(1\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438279421849)
content_description: Ensure proper read and write permissions are set for Marvelous Designer on your computer to prevent errors and enhance functionality.

title: Under what circumstances can the Academic license be purchased?
content: The Academic license is only available for purchase by qualified academic institutions. The Academic license can be used solely for educational purposes and should not be used for any other purposes. If the software is to be used for purposes other than teaching, an enterprise license must be purchased.
content_description: This web page outlines the eligibility and usage restrictions of the Academic license, available exclusively to qualified educational institutions for educational purposes only.

title: Does Marvelous Designer provide sample assets?
content: Marvelous Designer provides various sample assets that you can use from its library. Additionally, you can download both free and paid items from [CONNECT (Asset Store)](https://connect.clo-set.com/) and utilize them as well.
content_description: Discover and access a diverse library of sample assets and both free and paid items from CONNECT (Asset Store) to enhance your Marvelous Designer experience.

title: Account Integration FAQ User Guide (CLO-SET account)
content: ## **Objective** **Access all CLO Virtual Fashion services using a single email account.** This FAQ will cover the updates and changes to login methods for **Marvelous Designer** **Personal** & **Student** license account types. This change will NOT affect Enterprise & Academic account types at this time. Please check the general [FAQ](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us) if you have questions about the account merging process (CLO-SET accounts). ## ## **Details** ### 1) Change in sign-in method **Effective date on** the release of Marvelous Designer 2024.0. **What does this cover?** Marvelous Designer website / Software version 2024.0 and above. | **Software Version** **(12,11,10 and below)** | **Software Version** **Above 2024.0** ---|---|--- **How to login** | **Existing User ID & Password** | **CLO-SET Account & Password ** #### ### 2) How do I get a “CLO-SET Account & Password” if I have an existing Marvelous Designer ID? Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 3) What is the difference between a CLO-SET account and my previous Marvelous Designer ID? With your old Marvelous Designer ID you had to have multiple logins to access all of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services. Now with one CLO-SET account you can access all CLO Virtual Fashion services without additional logins. #### ### 4) I am using a perpetual license for Marvelous Designer. Do I have to merge my account? You do not have to If you are only logging into Marvelous Designer software only. If you want to access the Marvelous Designer website, you will need to follow the on screen prompt to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Or you can check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261710929177)**. #### ### 5) Can I still use my Perpetual License after I merge my account with CLO-SET?** ** Yes**!** All data/assets/subscription information associated with your pre-existing account will remain the same. You can download your software licenses from the same location, in “[My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)” page. #### ### 6) How do I login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny after I merge my account? You can login to CLO / Marvelous Designer / Jinny with your CLO-SET Account & Password. #### ### 7) I have a subscription license for Marvelous Designer and I like to use an older version than 2024.0. Do I have to use a different sign in or can I use the CLO-SET account? * If you have an old installer on your device and you have access to versions below 12: Use the older login method. Login to the installed version you wish to use with your User ID & Password (same as before). * For 2024.0 and above: you can log in to all CLO Virtual Fashion product (CLO/Marvelous Designer/CONNECT/CLO-SET) websites and software with your CLO-SET account. ### 8) I bought items from the Marvelous Designer Store (before CONNECT existed). Where can I download my purchased items? All items purchased from the Marvelous Designer Store will be downloadable from [CONNECT's My Page > Purchase](https://connect.clo-set.com/mypage/purchase) tab. *This applies to purchases made after April 28, 2020 on the Marvelous Designer store page. If you have purchases made before April 28, 2020, those are still stored and downloadable from the Marvelous Designer > [My Account](https://marvelousdesigner.com/mypage) page. ### 9) I have both CLO and Marvelous Designer IDs and I use them frequently. How does it affect me? You no longer have to use two separate logins! You can continue using your licenses without functional change for both CLO and Marvelous Designer. All you have to do is sign in with your CLO-SET account. You can check the license information for your products on the CLO or Marvelous Designer websites. ### 10) I like to use different email addresses for CLO and Marvelous Designer for my own reasons and want to keep them separate. Can I still have separate accounts? Yes, make sure to use the different email addresses for your CLO-SET merge so that you will have two separate CLO-SET accounts. The accounts are tied to each email address and the licenses associated with each account will be included in that merge. If you wish to unify your email addresses in the future or have other questions, please contact our support team at [support@clo-set.com](mailto:support@clo-set.com) or **[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new)**. ### 11) I am using my software in an offline environment. Does this change affect me? Your access to your software will remain unaffected, you can continue using your pre-existing account user ID & password without change. If you choose to sign in to the websites for any of the CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) products and services you will be prompted to merge your account into a CLO-SET account. Check out our detailed step-by-step guide **[HERE](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261721190041-Account-Merging-from-CLO-SET)**. ### 12) How do I change my password after I merge my accounts into a CLO-SET account? When you click 'Change Password' on the Marvelous Designer website or any CLO Virtual Fashion (CVF) product page, you will be redirected to the CLO-SET ‘[My Page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)’, where you can change your password. If you are already on the CLO-SET website, you can change the password under the settings tab on “[My page](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount)”. * If you are using a version of the software below 2024.0, your password for the software will not be synchronized with CLO-SET account. **See Question 13 if you want to change your password for an older version. ### 13) I'm using a version of Marvelous Designer that is below 2024.0 (Version 12,11,10, 9, etc). How do I change my password for my software login? * If you have integrated into the CLO-SET account: contact us via [the Marvelous Designer support team](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new). * If you don’t have an integrated CLO-SET account: reset your password via the [password reset page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/member/identify). ### 14) What happens to my subscription cycle if I change my account email? Changing your account email will NOT impact your subscription cycle or payment information. Please note that the email notifications on the renewal and payment confirmation will be sent to your original email registered at the point of subscription. ### 15) I have paid CLO-SET or CLO accounts, does this mean I get Marvelous Designer for free? No, the integration is only for login methods not purchasing and licensing. The paid CLO-SET and CLO services will remain separate from each other and require their own purchases for use. **If you need assistance regarding accounts merging or have questions, please contact us at******[**support@clo-set.com**](mailto:support@clo-set.com) **or[submit a request](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/requests/new), and our support team will promptly respond to your inquiry.**
content_description: This web page aims to provide essential information and guidance on the updated login methods for accessing all CLO Virtual Fashion services through a single CLO-SET account, specifically for Marvelous Designer Personal and Student license users.

title: Refund Policy for Cancellations
content: ### **ESSENTIALS** ## **Target:****Personal Accounts** ## **Plan:****Monthly** ## **Situation:** When a **trial automatically converts** to a Monthly subscription ### **POLICY** To prevent unexpected charges and reduce inconvenience for our users, we provide a 24-hour grace period right after your trial converts to a Monthly plan. Within this time frame, you can cancel and get a full refund if you decide not to continue. Cancel within 24 hours → Eligible for a full refund. * Your subscription will be terminated immediately. * You will lose access to the service right away. Cancel after 24 hours → No refund. * You will retain access until the end of the current billing cycle. * Direct purchase of Monthly (without trial) → No refund policy applies. ### **HOW TO CANCEL AND GET REFUNDS** 1. Go to License Tab of My Page and click [Refund available in n hours]. **![selfRefund1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938689639449)** 2. Proceed with Cancel Subscription. **Start Cancel Subscription** **![selfRefund2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662660249)** **Check Refund Information** **![selfRefund3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662662553)** **Survey** **![selfRefund4.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938689647385)** 3\. Check your email to confirm your cancellation. **![selfRefund5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/50938662666777)** If you purchase a Monthly plan directly without a trial, the refund policy does not apply. In this case, canceling your subscription will only stop the auto-renewal, and you will still retain access to the service until the end of your current billing cycle.
content_description: This page provides essential information about our refund policy and cancellation process for users whose trial subscriptions automatically convert to a Monthly plan.

title: How to uninstall Marvelous Designer completely
content: In the process of Live Update or alternately using multiple Marvelous Designer versions, various files, and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software may be damaged, causing the Marvelous Designer software to not operate normally. You can solve this problem by completely uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software and configuration files and then reinstalling it with the latest Marvelous Designer installer. # **Note** * Only the files and settings that make up the Marvelous Designer software are deleted, and user-created files remain. * Before uninstalling the Marvelous Designer software, please back up your files safely. * If you have changed the Marvelous Designer install path, find the path and delete it. * * * # **Windows** ### 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website * Under the Marvelous Designer Help menu, select Logout or Deactivate License (software remote logout). * [Software remote logout from the website >](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358197591961) ### 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software * Go to Windows Start > Settings > Apps or Installed Apps > Marvelous Designer Software and click Uninstall. * If you have installed different product types or multiple versions, uninstall all Marvelous Designer software using the above method. ![001.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438781014169) ### 3 Delete Registry * Windows Search > Type _'Registry Editor'_ > open as administrator > delete the Marvelous Designer registry. * Path: _Computer\HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Marvelous Designer Network OnlineAuth_ * In the case of individual user version, it is displayed as _~\Marvelous Designer Standalone OnlineAuth._ * If you don't see the Marvelous Designer product name in the Windows Registry, all have been deleted. ![002.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438791433881) ### 4 Delete Marvelous Designer install folder and Assets folder * Even after deleting the program, additional downloaded files and some configurations may remain. * The default install path is C:\Program Files\Marvelous Designer {product name}, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. ### 5 Delete Marvelous Designer Assets folder from Windows shared folder * The default install path is C:\Users\Public\Documents\Marvelous Designer, select and delete the entire Marvelous Designer folder. ### 6 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files * Some Marvelous Designer configuration files are stored as hidden files. * Go to Windows File Explorer > Options > Folder Options. * Select 'Show hidden files' as shown below and click the 'Apply to Folders' button. ![007_Folder_option.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438791595417) * Go to C:\Users\\{Windows user name}\AppData\Local, select the CLO folder, and delete it. (Marvelous Designer App data folders are inside of the CLO folder) ![005_hidden.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438776328473) * * * **Mac** ### 1 Logging out of Marvelous Designer Software or deactivating from the website * From the HELP Menu, Log Out or Deactivate License of Marvelous Designer. The application will Quit. * [Software remote logout from the website >](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358197591961) ### 2 Uninstall Marvelous Designer software * Open the MAIN APPLICATION folder on your computer. NOT the Application folder in the User Folder. * Find the Marvelous Designer, Right-Click & Move to Trash. Only do this if you want to fully uninstall Marvelous Designer. ![MD_001.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438781678617) ### 3 Delete the Marvelous Designer Assets folder * To remove all the Marvelous Designer Assets, go into your DOCUMENTS Folder. Delete the Marvelous Designer Folder there. ![MD_002.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438792256281) ### 4 Delete hidden Marvelous Designer files * Go to your HOME Folder, use Column & navigate to the Go Menu. Note the contents on the menu and in the items in the Home folder. Release the menu. ![MD_003.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438782205337) * Type SHIFT + COMMAND + PERIOD (.) this will activate hidden items. * A few things will show up in the Applications folder. Return to the Go Menu and note that “LIBRARY” is now visible and there are more Items available in the Home folder. Some are dimmed. These are items that are normally hidden. * Go into the LIBRARY folder and delete the Marvelous Designer folder under the APPLICATION SUPPORT folder. ![MD_004.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438798786713) * Next, still in the Library, go into Preferences. * Select all the files that begin with COM.Marvelous Designer. (The full name will differ depending on which version of the software you downloaded and installed). * Right-Click on one of the selected files and Move to Trash. * Empty your Trash. ![MD_005.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438777533593) **Note** * If you have deleted only the Marvelous Designer Preferences files, when you start Marvelous Designer again it will be as if it is opening for the first time; you will need to input your login information, add your Favorites to the Library and customize your User Settings.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide to completely uninstall and reinstall Marvelous Designer software to resolve issues caused by damaged files and settings.

title: Video Capture (ver. 2024.0)
content: ### Video Capture (ver. 2024.0) ### Capture a video of recorded animation to view in real time. ### Steps 1\. Open the Animation Editor. 2\. Record the animation. 3\. Select Video Capture from any of the locations below Main Menu ▶ Animation ▶ Video Capture Animation Editor Toolbar ▶ Video Capture Timeline Menu (Right Click)▶ Video Capture 4\. Set the video recording properties. Display | Size preset | Set the size of the video that will be recorded. The format is shown below. * 1920 X 1080 (16:9) * 1280 X 720 (16:9) * 800 X 450 (16:9) * 1024 X 768(4:3) * 640 X 480(4:3) * Fit to Window : Size of 3D Window * Custom * Full Screen : Monitor Size ---|---|--- Width | Set the width of the video to be recorded Height | Set the height of the video to be recorded File | Format | Set the format of the file to save. * Window : MP4 / AVI * MacOS : MP4 / MOV Save as File | Name | Name the video. Saving path | Specify the location where you want to save the video. Autoseq Numbering | The video name is automatically saved with a new number. 5\. Click the Capture button. → The Capture is executed. → When executing capture, the capture button will change to a stop button, and the capture process can be terminated with the stop button. ### End Result 1\. Check the captured video → The frame range captured will match the playback start and end in the Animation Editor Settings. If the capture in terminated mid execution, start frame to time terminated will be captured. → When the capture ends, the video will be automatically launched to the set media player in your computer. ※ Note: * You cannot run video capture without animation. * You can only capture the movement of the camera in the 3D Window
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for using the Video Capture feature in the Animation Editor to record and save animations in real time.

title: Wind Controller Setting (Above ver. 2024.0)
content: ### Objective You can add a wind effect to the 3D Window to create the impression that your garment is being affected by the wind. You can change the wind settings with several options. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶ Show Wind Controller View icon in 3D Window ▶ Environment ▶ Show Wind Controller ### Operation #### **Activate Wind Effect** 1\. Follow this path → The wind controller appears in a 3D window in the shape of a wind. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438689251225) 2\. Click the Wind controller → A gizmo appears on the Wind controller and properties for the wind appear in the Property Editor. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438679011225) 3\. click the checkbox under Wind → Activate. → The Activate checkbox will be ticked to activate the wind. 4\. Click the Simulation button. → Wind is activated in the 3D window. #### **Wind Direction Setting** 1\. Follow this path Main menu → View → Environment view icon → Show Wind Controller → The wind controller appears in a 3D window in the shape of a wind. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438689251225) 2\. Click on the Wind Controller → The gizmo is activated. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438679011225) 3\. Use the gizmo to adjust the position and direction of the wind, the wind flows in the direction of the icon and arrow. 4\. Click Simulation. → In the 3D window, the wind blows at the position and direction you adjusted. #### **Multiple Wind Setting** **** 1\. Create or duplicate a Wind Controller. Create: Scene Browser → Select Wind group, Right-click → Create Wind Duplicate: Scene Browser → Select Wind Controller in the Wind group, Right-click → Duplicate Environment icon in 3D Window window → View Wind Controller → Select Wind icon in 3D window → Right-click → Duplicate #### **Wind Properties Setting** 1\. Follow the corresponding path: Main Menu → View → Show Wind Controller → The Wind Controller appears in the 3D Window. 2\. Click the wind controller. → The properties for the wind appear in the Property Editor. 3\. In the Property Editor, set the wind options according to your preference. Name | Changes name of the wind according to the user preference. ---|--- Wind | Activate | Sets the activation status of the wind. Unlimited Bound | It is activated by default and affects the whole space depending on its position and direction. Type | Type Sets the type of the wind. Spherical: The wind blows in spherical shape, in every direction starting from the Wind Controller. ![44.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438689923993) Planar: The wind blows only from the designated direction, regardless of the Wind Controller's location. ![55.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438679505817) Strength | Sets the intensity of the wind. The higher the value, the stronger the wind. Decay [0~100] | Sets the range of the wind. The wind draws an arc and blows weaker according to the set value of wind intensity. If the value is "0", it blows in a straight line endlessly. Frequency (sec) | Sets the cycle of the wind. The wind repeatably blows weaker and stronger in interval of set value of seconds. If the value is "0", it blows regularly. Turbulence [0~100] | Sets the turbulence of wind intensity. The higher the value, the more irregular the wind intensity. Rotation Key Activate | Activate to allow the wind animation rotation value to be set by the animation key. Translation | X | Sets Key to the X position value Y | Sets Key to the Y position value Z | Sets Key to the Z position value
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on activating and customizing wind effects in the 3D Window for dynamic garment simulation in your design environment.

title: PBR Map Generator (Ver. 2024.1)
content: ### ### ### Objective PBR Map can be automatically generated and applied to graphic images or imported BaseColor Map Texture Maps ### Location Property Editor ▶ Materials ### Operation 1. Apply graphic with [apply texture map](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358377731865) or [apply graphic Image.](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358239678745) 2. Click Create PBR Map button ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438007044761) next to the map channels→ Create PBR map is supported for Displacement Map, Opacity Map, Roughness Map, and Metalness Map ※ Note: * The generated PBR Map is automatically stored in the AppData path. Click on the Map thumbnail image to check the save path. * This feature applies to fabric, button, trim, graphic, buttonhole, topstitch, and puckering ### End Result * You can automatically generate PBR maps for different channels.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for automatically generating and applying PBR maps to graphic images and BaseColor Map Texture Maps within the Property Editor of your design software.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Style
content: **New in 2025.1** Add Properties Assign Options **** Ability to easily manage and edit Zipper by style in the Object Browser. **** #### **Add** 1. Add a zipper style by clicking the Add button in the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953065622681) zipper tab of the object browser, or [create a zipper](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358168494745-ZIPPER-Create-Zippers) directly in the 3D window. → A zipper with the default style will be added. **📝Note:** _You can copy an existing zipper style with the same settings by clicking the**Copy** button._ #### **Properties** **Style** 1. Select the added style in the Zipper tab to set its properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | Enter the zipper’s name. Each component of the zipper style, such as the chain, slider, puller, or stopper, can be named individually. **Function** | Set the zipper to be one-way or two-way. For two-way zippers, you can set the locking direction to either head-to-head or Bottom-to-Bottom. Changing the slider material will be applied identically to both sides. **Type** | Set the zipper type (Plastic, Nylon, Metal, etc.). **Specification** | Set the zipper gauge. The zipper width and the size of the slider, puller, and stopper can be adjusted individually **Save/Open** | Save or open the zipper style as a .ZPS file. → The changes will be applied to all 3D zippers using the selected style. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953065624601)** **Each Component** Adjust chain, slider, and puller properties in more detail. 1. Click the corresponding chain, slider, puller, or stopper using the **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953229186073)****Select/Move** tool. **• Select All** **** When you select one of the slider, puller, or stopper components, all related parts are selected at once. **• Select Component** If all components are currently selected, clicking one again will select only that component. **• Select Part of a Component** If a component consists of multiple meshes, clicking it again allows you to select a specific part. 2. Set selected component properties. **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- **Chain** | **Length** | Adjust the length of the Zipper teeth. **Particle Distance** | Adjust the particle distance of the zipper tape pattern. **Fold** | Adjust the Strength and Angle of the fold for Sewing between the Zipper and Pattern. **Physical Property** | Adjust physical properties of zipper tape pattern. **Slider/Puller/Stopper** | **Size/Weight** | Set the size and weight of each component individually. **Fasten** | Select the zip direction, and select a side of the zipper tape where the slider will locate when the zipper is open. **Material Type, Material** | Materials can be changed to each selected component, allowing for more diverse appearances. **Save/Open** | Save or open the zipper style as a .ZPS file. **** #### **Apply** 1. Select a zipper with**![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953229186073)**Select/Move tool. 2. Click ![assign text.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953065632281) **Assgin to New Zipper** in the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953065622681) zipper tab of the object browser. → The default zipper style will be added and applied simultaneously. 3. Or, click **![Assign.png](/guide-media/01J8712WNNAT1HG0EGPMJ1FX7C)Assign to Selected Zipper** next to another style. → The selected zipper will be changed. **** #### **Options** Right-click on the ziper style in the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48953065622681) zipper tab of the object browser. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete** | Delete the selected zipper style, or delete all unused zipper styles at once. _**✨Tip:**_ _Zipper styles can also be deleted by clicking the Delete icon, but styles that are currently in use cannot be removed._ **Rename** | Rename the zipper style. _**✨Tip:** You can also rename a zipper style by double-clicking its name directly._ **Reset** | Reset the selected zipper to the default style.
content_description: Explore the new features in 2025.1 that simplify zipper management and customization in the Object Browser for enhanced design flexibility.

title: Strengthen / Unstrengthen
content: ### Objective Apply a Hardened simulation state to patterns in the 3D window. ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ 3D Garment Right-Click Pop-up Menu ▶ Strengthen / Unstrengthen 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Pattern ▶ 2D Pattern Right-Click Pop-up Menu ▶ Strengthen / Unstrengthen ### Operation 1\. Use the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358253652633) Transform Pattern tool to select patterns 2\. Right-click, in the pop-up menu select Strengthen. or use hotkeys: Ctrl + H (Windows), Ctrl + L (MAC) → The selected patterns will temporarily gain strength and express clean folds where fold angles are applied 3\. To unstrengthen, right-click, in the pop-up menu select Unstrengthen. or use hotkeys: Ctrl + H (Windows), Ctrl + L (MAC) → The strengthen effect will be removed. ※ Note: * When the Patterns are strengthened properly, they turn orange in color. * Right-click to open the 3D Background Options Menu ▶ Show/Hide Color [(Show/Hide 3D Color Ver. 2024.1)](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358311619225)[ ](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/32523191112473/preview/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpZCI6MzI1MjMxOTExMTI0NzMsImV4cCI6MTcxNTk3NDk0Mn0.vTz8AEFpwglRHaNeFb09thKYnyuNna7SAvTfH7sSS8U)to hide Strengthen color display in the 3D window ### End Result The strengthened patterns will temporarily gain stiffness to all properties and express clean folds where fold angles are applied.
content_description: This webpage provides a concise guide on how to apply and remove a Hardened simulation state to patterns in the 3D window using the Strengthen and Unstrengthen tools.

title: Show / Hide 3D Color (Ver. 2024.1)
content: ### Objective Toggle on and off the color of the state ([Freeze](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358315135897), [Solidify](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358310357529),[ Strengthen,](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358253657497) [Layer](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358288780441), [Subdivide](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358174692249)) applied to Pattern and Mesh in the 3D Window. ### Location 3D Background Options Menu ▶ Show/Hide Color ### Operation #### Using 3D Background Options Menu 1. Right-click the background in 3D window to activate menu 2. Select Show/Hide color 3. Select preferred option ※ Note: * This can be executed for Pattern and Mesh, respectively. * Not only can you show/hide individually, but you can also show/hide them all. ### End Result State defined color (freeze, solidify, strengthen, layer, subdivide) should now be hidden when menu options are selected.
content_description: This webpage provides instructions for toggling the visibility of state-defined colors (Freeze, Solidify, Strengthen, Layer, Subdivide) applied to Pattern and Mesh within the 3D Window of the application.

title: Apply a V2C file for Software License Key
content: **[Software License Key for Network Offline] Applying a V2C file for License key update** 1\. Download the V2C file sent from Marvelous Designer Support Team. 2\. Click on the link below to access the ACC Page, then select “Update/Attach” in Options on the left. **(Click here to link [ACC Page](http://localhost:1947/_int_/ACC_help_index.html))** **![2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438738607385)** 3\. If the update is successful, the following message will be printed. ![5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438739162521) **[Double Checking an updated License Key]** If the License Key Update process is successfully completed, you will be able to double check by following the steps below. 1\. title: 2D Pattern Window Ruler (Ver. 2024.1)
content: ### Objective Place 2D elements or create pattern using Ruler and Guidelines in 2D Window. ### Location 2D Window ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438159864985)2D Information ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438110261785)Show Ruler 2D Window ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438159864985)2D Information ▶ ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438143122329)Show Guideline ### Operation #### Show/Hide Ruler and Settings 1\. In the 2D window, click **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438159864985)**2D Information ▶![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438110261785) Show Ruler **→** Ruler appears in 2D window. 2\. Right click on Ruler to change the unit (Inch, Centimeter, Millimeter). 3\. Click and drag the cross point on the top left of the tape measure to change the origin point. ※ Note: The ruler is automatically scaled according to the mouse wheel up and down. #### Set Ruler Origin Point 1\. Click and drag at the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438160968217) empty square in the upper left corner of the ruler. 2\. When dragged, a white crosshair will be displayed. 3\. When the mouse click is released, the origin point is set to the crosshair position. ※ Note: To re-initialize the origin point: double-click or right-click the empty square in the upper left corner of the ruler. #### Create, Move and Show/Hide Guidelines 1\. Turn on Show Ruler. 2\. Click and drag either the vertical or the horizontal ruler. **→** A guideline is created. 3\. Click and drag the created guideline to move it. → The guide line is moved. 4\. In the 2D window, click **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438159864985)**2D Information ▶![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438143122329) Show Guideline → The guide display is toggled on or off. ※ Note: * A guideline adjacent to pattern points will snap to the point. Conversely, a pattern point will snap to the adjacent guideline. * If Show Guideline is disabled, it will automatically set to activate when a new guideline is created. * Show Guideline can operate independently from Show Ruler. (Even if Show Ruler is turned off, Show Guideline is maintained.) * Hold down Ctrl key on the keyboard and drag at either the vertical or the horizontal ruler to create a guideline at the opposite axis. #### Set Guideline Options #### **Right Click Options** Offset Guideline | Create a new guideline at regular intervals [(in the Offset internal Line popup window)](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358442871705) based on the selected guideline. ---|--- Lock Guideline | Lock the selected guideline. ※ Note: * Right click on a locked guideline to find the option for Unlock Guideline to unlock selected guideline. * Right-Click on empty space in the 2D window, in the popup window you can select ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438133529497)Lock All Guidelines or Unlock All Guidelines to lock or unlock all the guidelines. Delete Guideline | Delete the selected guideline. ※ Note: * Hold Shift key on keyboard to select multiple guidelines, you can delete selected guidelines by executing Delete Guideline. Delete All Guidelines | Delete all guidelines in the 2D window. #### #### **Offset Guideline Options** Number of Offsets | Number of Guidelines to be created ---|--- Distance | Set how to give a distance value. * All: Apply the same distance value to all Guidelines * Individual: Apply different distance values to each guideline * When set to individual, new options appears (ex: #1, #2) which allows number input for each individual guideline Offset from | Offset reference point. From: * Previous line : Apply distance value from the previous Guideline (gray ghost lines). * selected line : Apply distance value from selected Original Guideline. Reverse Direction | Create in the opposite direction from the current direction. Both Sides | Create in both directions based on the Original Guideline. ### End Result Add ruler and ruler guidelines to 2D window.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive instructions for placing 2D elements and creating patterns using the ruler and guidelines in the 2D window of the software.

title: [Beta] AI Texture Generator (Ver. 2024.1)
content: ### ### ### Objective Easily type in keywords to generate different texture images to choose from to create new fabric textures. ### Location Fabric Style Window ▶ Fabric Property ▶ Material ▶ Basic Parameter **▶![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438690502553) **AI Texture Generator button ### Operation 1. Select a Fabric Style from Fabric Style window. 2. Under Fabric Properties ▶ Materials ▶ Click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438690502553) AI Texture Generator button on the right side of the Basic Parameters. → AI Texture Generator window appears. 3. Set options, enter prompts, and click the Generate button. → An AI texture image is created. 4. Check the generated image in the preview window. → The generated image is stored in History. 5. Click generate again to generate more images. 6. Click Apply button, the selected image is applied as the Fabric Texture. ### **Generate AI Texture Options** Fabric Type | Select the fabric type. The pattern is generated on the texture of the selected fabric. ---|--- Content Type | Select content types. None | Create an image without specifying characteristics of the texture image. Art | Select the style of the texture image: * Cartoon, Water Color Painting, Croquis, Oil Painting, Vintage Print | Select the repeated-pattern type: * Camouflage, Tartan Check, Paisley, Polka dot, Stripe Pattern Size | Adjusts only the size of the pattern while maintaining the size of the material texture. Text Prompt | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** * Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![ai1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438680279961) * **Emphasize Certain Words.** * Parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, parentheses on certain words place more weight on those words. Weight increase rate: **(word)** 1.1times, **((word))** 1.21times. * * ![ai2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438680700569) ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438680845593)Maintain Prompt | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI texture image is Newly generated each time. Thus, clicking the "Maintain Result" button may update the prompts while maintaining the characteristics of the previously generated result as much as possible. **※** Note**:** It may differ from the existing result depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358351053465)Random | The sample prompt is randomly applied. The option automatically changes to a type specific to the prompt. History | Previously generated images with prompts are recorded as "histories". The history remains accessible until Marvelous Designer is closed. If you select a previously created image in History and click Apply, the image is applied as Texture. ※ Note : * It may take a while to create when there are many users generating AI texture image at the same time. * Fabric Type must be set and the Text Prompt must be input to generate. * The resulting generated images are only a preview until Apply is selected.
content_description: "Effortlessly create and customize unique fabric textures by entering keywords into our AI Texture Generator."
